data_status: RETROSPECTIVE_TWO_FOLD_FEASIBILITY; native baseline margins have not previously been stored in the cited effect receipts; diagnostic only until a fresh-corpus validation
purpose: Test the smallest explicit semantic baseline generators that could remove the v4 actuator's final native-margin input without row identity, lexical features, template tables, or outcome-conditioned rank search.

frozen_folds.task14: within each direction-by-template group, sort row_id and alternate rows between folds; all sixteen E/A/U/W subsets remain attached to their row
frozen_folds.bracket: sort the 36 row_id values and alternate rows between folds; both endpoint directions remain attached to their row

models.task14: ordinary least squares with six coefficients: intercept, direction sign, and four E/A/U/W membership indicators; no template, row, lexical, or subset-interaction feature
models.bracket: ordinary least squares with five coefficients: intercept, two recipient-closer contrasts, and two donor-closer contrasts; no row, family, text, side, or interaction feature

predictions.pred_a_instrument_and_folds: Task14 decomposition closure and bracket replay error are at most 1e-4; row-disjoint folds cover all 512 and 72 targets exactly once.
predictions.pred_b_task14_semantic_baseline: Cross-fitted Task14 baseline margins pass the overall and each-fold baseline bars with exactly six coefficients per fold.
predictions.pred_c_bracket_semantic_baseline: Cross-fitted bracket baseline margins pass the overall and each-fold baseline bars with exactly five coefficients per fold.
predictions.pred_d_absolute_counterfactual_margins: Adding the immutable v4 effects to cross-fitted baselines passes all counterfactual bars separately for Task14 and bracket targets.
predictions.pred_e_fixed_price_and_scope: Exactly four closed-form fits, four physical model forwards, 680 example evaluations, no backwards or parameter updates, and no row/template/lexical feature.

terminal.feasibility_screen: All five predictions pass. Freeze coefficients from all diagnostic rows, construct an untouched corpus, and prospectively validate before promotion.
terminal.null: Any valid scientific failure closes this smallest semantic-linear baseline route; do not add row, template, lexical, interaction, or higher-rank features post hoc.
terminal.invalid: Instrument, fold, authority, or price failure only.
